g.text: Provider rates; only Opus 5.5 input/output include the verified 10% U-M adjustment. No blanket fee. Cache charges excluded.

g.text: GPT-6 prices: ≤272K input; Gemini prices: through 31 Dec 2026. Token price is not cost per completed task.

g.text: GPT-6/Gemini: medium. Sonnet: labeled effort. Haiku/K2.5: reasoning. DeepSeek/K3: max. Llama: non-reasoning.

g.text: Opus/Fable: medium, evaluator's default fallback. No uncertainty intervals supplied; small score gaps may not be meaningful.
